audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the packet chart and with the already-audited mirror (trundle__shen): rows 0, 1 and 6 were wrong, and full/content layers matched each other only by accident.
audit.why: Mirror set the chart to Skill / Shen / Shen / Shen / Trundle / Shen / Skill. Shen wins 55.74% over 732 games, so the early rows should not read as a Trundle lead, and the 2+ item row is genuinely contested because Subjugate (R) scales off the resistances Shen stacks.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0] Trundle->Skill, phases[1]/win[1] Skill->Shen, phases[6]/win[6] Shen->Skill, with ratings moved to match. Only Level 6 stays Trundle.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and cooldown text never gave a number: 'Subjugate online', 'Respect it', 'your ultimate'.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80s and doubles its steal over 4 seconds; Stand United is 200/180/160s. Those figures are what make 'fight on his cooldown' actionable.
audit.corrected: 120s Subjugate and 200s Stand United written into breakdown.cooldowns; the 2+ item spike keeps the resistance-steal framing that his R scaling creates.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one of Trundle's five abilities was ever named (King's Tribute, Chomp, Frozen Domain, Pillar of Ice, Subjugate), and Chomp's effect was described only as 'his bite'.
audit.why: Chomp is a 3.5s auto-reset that saps AD; Frozen Domain (W) raises his attack speed, move speed and ALL healing; Pillar of Ice (E, 21s at rank 1) is real terrain that can wall Shadow Dash; King's Tribute heals him a percent of the max HP of anything that dies near him, which is why Grievous Wounds timing decides long trades; Subjugate steals Health, Armor and MR, so stacking raw resistances feeds it.
audit.corrected: Real names carried into tldr, winCon, whys[0], spikes[2], breakdown.cooldowns and wants.foe[1], with the anti-heal and resistance-steal interactions stated rather than implied.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged "Twilight Assault's" in early as a probable wrong name. It is a FALSE POSITIVE — Twilight Assault is Shen's real Q. Left untouched.

edits.before: His bite shreds your HP — anti-heal, E-taunt him. Shen wins the Subjugate cooldown windows.
edits.after: Chomp saps your AD — anti-heal him, taunt him into your W. Shen wins Subjugate's 120s window.

edits.before: Anti-heal and taunt him out. Track Subjugate before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Anti-heal King's Tribute, taunt him into Spirit's Refuge, and commit while Subjugate is down.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Respect it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Subjugate: 120s at rank 1 — it steals your Health, Armor and MR and doubles over 4s. Track it before every engage. - Pillar of Ice: 21s at rank 1, and it can wall off Shadow Dash. - Stand United: 200s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Trundle can Q-auto freely at Level 1 before your W or E are available — respect his early aggression and trade only with Twilight Assault tip damage from max range.
edits.after: Chomp is a 3.5s auto-reset that saps your AD, but it costs mana every cast — hold Twilight Assault range, take the last hits, and neither of you can force a level-1 kill.

edits.before: Sunfire Aegis procs on every taunted Trundle auto inside your W zone — his sustain cannot outpace the combined chip from passive burn plus your Q magic-damage empowered autos.
edits.after: Sunfire Aegis procs on every taunted auto inside Spirit's Refuge — King's Tribute healing off dying minions cannot outpace the burn plus your empowered Twilight Assault autos.

edits.before: Stack Corrupting Potion sustain early and absorb your short trades until his Q steals enough AD to tip exchanges
edits.after: Drag the trade into Frozen Domain (W), where his attack speed, move speed and healing rise, until Chomp's AD sap tips it

notes: packet.suspectNames flagged "Twilight Assault's" as a probable wrong ability name — it is a false positive; Twilight Assault is Shen's real Q. Anti-heal is stated as an interaction (King's Tribute + Frozen Domain's healing amp) rather than as an item timing, since I cannot verify from the kits when Grievous Wounds should be bought. Whether Pillar of Ice cancels an in-flight Shadow Dash or merely blocks the path is NOT in Riot's text — I wrote only 'can wall off Shadow Dash', which the terrain flag supports.
